name: Hush
subtitle: part two: Thursday
story: On Thursday afternoon, as promised, her answer came across the valley. Half the town stood in the snow to hear it. It was yes. Then, a few seconds later and very faintly, a second word: 'obviously'. They are getting married in spring. The vows have to be shouted five days early to arrive on time.
hook: Hush, part two. Her answer finally crossed the valley.
beats: Half the town came out to hear it.
It was yes. Then, a few seconds later, very faintly: 'obviously'.
odd_line: The wedding is in spring. The vows go out five days early.
rule: Wedding vows must be shouted at least five days in advance.
question: What would you shout across the valley?
extra: If you missed part one: on Hush, a shout takes five days to cross the valley.
reel_lines: Sound is slow on Hush. A shout takes five days to cross the valley.
So arguments are done by letter. By the time the reply lands, nobody remembers why.
